{{Short description|Spanish-Arab Mathematician (c.1400 - 1489)}}
{{Redirect|Al-Umawi|the Emir of Cordoba|Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Umawi}}

'''Abū ʿAbdallāh Yaʿīsh ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Yūsuf ibn Simāk al-Andalusī al-Umawī''' ({{Langx|ar|يعيش بن إبراهيم بن يوسف بن سماك الأموي الأندلسي}}) <!-- commonly known as '''al-Umawī''') --> (1400? in [[Al-Andalus]] – 1489 in [[Damascus]], [[Mamluk Sultanate]]) was a 15th-century Spanish-[[Arab]]<ref>{{cite book|last1=Gibb|first1=Hamilton Alexander Rosskeen|last2=Kramers|first2=Johannes Hendrik|last3=Lewis|first3=Bernard|last4=Pellat|first4=Charles|last5=Schacht|first5=Joseph|title=The Encyclopaedia of Islam|date=1970|publisher=Brill|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BJbrAAAAMAAJ&q=%22Spanish-Arab+Ya%27ish+b.+Ibrahim%22|language=en}}</ref> [[mathematician]].

==Works==
*''Marasim al-intisab fi'ilm al-hisab'' ("On arithmetical rules and procedures"), first date written in 1373 and hence the birth date above is controversial.
*''Raf'al-ishkal fi ma'rifat al-ashkal'' (a work on mensuration).
